notes.title: Space exploration sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/50c2552896f801e8af7d520751958e012595a8ce.png[/img]


Dear friends!

That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind. Does this ring a bell? 50 years ago the space race took humans to the moon. For most of us, this is still a place reachable only in our dreams. The dream comes true this weekend - Steam is running a [b]special sale[/b] to honor this historical event! 

This means discounts for all space themed games! Go ahead, dreamers, 
to infinity and beyond!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/553210/Warhammer_40000_Space_Wolf/

[/list]

Thank you for your attention, and have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Steam Summer Sales
notes.content:
Those shining Steam Summer Sales
More often than not
Are hotter than hot
In a lot of good ways!

Good news — all of HeroCraft’s PC titles are getting a discount for the Steam Summer Sale! We've got something for every taste and occasion: adventure games and strategy titles, arcadey experience and turn-based RPGs - just pick the one you feel a connection with;)

But that's not all ;) This Friday, prepare for a special set of events across our titles.Each and everyone of you will be able to compete for a cool prize (or for all of the available prizes at once). 
There are no restrictions, simply have a little patience and be ready when June 28th hits the calendar.

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33134735-HeroCraft/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33134735/a885c5941462dbd50147c996f9dcc8a810867f18.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Hello, lovers of a good time!


The Halloween spirits have come and gone, yet the Autumn season is ripe with surprises! Discounts on all HeroCraft games can be found everywhere! 

Success! We’ve defeated the evil aliens in [b]Super Turbo Demon Busters![/b] and none of our soldiers got hurt in the process. A chainsaw in one hand, a medkit in the other, a [b]40% discount[/b] strapped to a military belt and a horde of creepy zombies ahead. Let’s roll!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/262810/Super_Turbo_Demon_Busters/

notes.title: Odysseus Kosmos: Episode 2 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/65080c609de19681736dbd2d07271bb3ae64d70e.gif[/img]

Welcome to the next chapter of the adventure game about Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest! In the second episode, you continue to solve the riddles of the space ship San Francisco and reveal the secrets of the ending of the first part.

New locations and mini-games await; they will help you learn about Odysseus’s past, as well as what has become of the Earth and what the San Francisco’s mission is! By the way, about the space ship: the flying metropolis will once again face dangers... and new residents.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/645820/Odysseus_Kosmos_and_his_Robot_Quest_Adventure_Game/

It's time to talk about what happened to Oddy and what the mission of the space ship San Francisco is!

notes.title: Super Turbo Demon Busters! vs. Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest
notes.content:
Hi, guys!

As you may know, we have two different old school games in dev.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/71e8ec1b2a905b4cf1b7f0bd24322f0e40b7d9e7.png[/img]

The first game is Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest. A classic comedy quest about being geeky and procrastinative in space! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/645820 

And the second game is Super Turbo Demon Busters! A rogue-like game about  space troopers escaping from a planet filled with monsters, nuclear fire, viruses and ironic humor. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/262810

We think both games are great. They share pixel graphics (which is pretty cool), enthralling gameplay and sly humor. On the other hand, they are completely different, so we are interested - which game you like more. 

To find it out, we decided to manage a GIVEAWAY for a game that the community will choose. VOTE for a game you like the most and remember - it's your privilege to decide which game will win the battle.

Here is the link: 
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1FzNyZQBt8L8Sorqe0CQB5P91ErOrQCLY2O-dUQ0hbUs

Next Friday we will giveaway 50 Steam keys among the voters.

Thanks and stay tuned!

p.s. don't forget to wishlist the games, if you like them =)
